image_description: A Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) is the main subject, positioned centrally on a rocky surface with a dark netting background. The crab displays a broad oval carapace with purplish-brown to reddish-brown coloration and lighter mottled patterns. It has five pairs of walking legs extending laterally, with the first pair modified into robust claws (chelipeds) that are dark-tipped. The eyes are stalked and protrude from the anterior carapace margin. The ventral surface appears cream to white. The exoskeleton has a smooth, glossy texture.
